main_text.p: Et habendo ad amarsi ouer ad amare, weil man zulieben hat, oder weil zuliebẽ ist. Cum amandus sit.
main_text.head: DECLINATIO VERBI ACTIVI, SECVNDÆ CONIVGATIONIS. Der andern Zeitwandlung.
main_text.p: IO tengo, ego teneo, ich halt. Tu tieni, tu tenes, du heltest. Colui tiene, ille tenet, er helt. Noi teniamo, nos tenemus, wir halten. Voi tenete, vos tenetis, jhr haltet. Coloro tengono, illi tenent, sie halten.

Io teneua, ego tenebam, ich hielte. Tu teneui, tu tenebas, du hieltest. Colui teneua, ille tenebat, er hielte. Noi teneuamo, nos tenebamus, wir hielten. Voi teneuate, vos tenebatis, jhr hieltet. Coloro teneuano, & teneano, illi tenebant, sie hielten.
Io tenni, ego tenui, ich hab gehalten. Tu tenesti, tu tenuisti, du hast gehalten. Colui tenne, ille tenuit, er hat gehalten.

page.notes: Catchword/signature at the foot: "I 4" is the gathering signature and "Noi" is the catchword to the next page. Page number 135 printed top right; the printed "14" at the foot is a signature mark. Some italic/roman words are approximate in the scan.
